score_rules.RAW: retained lower over all legal actions

tie_rule: maximum exact floating score; lexicographically smallest action on exact tie
counterfactual_eligibility: all22 contexts times3 arms in a source-complete RAW-exact stream have all legal actions decomposable; compare RAW on the same mask
raw_eligibility: all22 contexts times3 arms source-complete and RAW-exact
unavailable_policy: retain RAW and reasons; both counterfactuals unavailable if any legal action is undecomposed; no known-subset argmax or replacement
primary_unit: one reused suffix stream; equal weights over fixed22 contexts
interval: two-sided95% Student t Monte Carlo interval of stream-level paired means
